title: A short walk with Patch

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Everyone’s meeting at the shelter by the pond for your birthday walk. I’ll take Patch on rough ground. Jo is at work. She sent two messages: one for the group, one just for you.
turns.zh: 大家會在池塘邊的遮棚集合，陪妳生日散步。路不平的地方我來牽帕奇。喬要上班。她寄了兩段留言，一段給大家，一段只給妳。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I can use the walking frame with one hand on pavement, but I can’t hold the leash and release that gate latch. The gate won’t stay open. Yesterday Patch circled behind me on the long leash.
turns.zh: 在鋪好的路上，我可以單手用助行架，但沒辦法一邊牽狗一邊打開那道門閂。門也不會自己保持開著。昨天牽繩一長，帕奇就繞到我背後。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The garden walkway is paved through the gate. The trail by the river begins across wet grass. Oh, the online album lets us add captions, but the clips play without sound.
turns.zh: 花園小徑連穿過門那段都鋪好了。河邊小路的入口得穿過濕草地。對了，線上紀念冊可以加文字說明，但短片播放時沒有聲音。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I want to lead him from the far side of the garden gate all the way to the shelter. Could we start over there?
turns.zh: 我想從花園門的另一邊一路牽牠到遮棚。我們能從那邊開始嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Sure. On the short leash he stays at my knee. At the river bridge he pulls sideways even on that leash. The first bench comes before the bridge.
turns.zh: 可以。用短牽繩時，牠會跟在我膝蓋旁。但到河邊的橋上，即使用短牽繩，牠也會往旁邊拉。第一張長椅在橋前。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Good. Let’s take the group photo before people go home. Jo asked us to put ‘a little of the walk’ with her message. The one for everyone starts with a joke about Patch.
turns.zh: 好，我們趁大家還沒回家時拍張合照。喬說要在她的留言旁放「一小段散步的內容」。給大家的那段留言，開頭開了個關於帕奇的玩笑。
